recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中倍下以芽細胞為主，下方中央有一顆細胞質帶空泡、兩個核葉完全分開的異常巨核細胞（separated nuclear lobes），部分顆粒球顆粒減少；芽細胞增加加上巨核系發育不良，符合 inv(3) AML 的抹片表現。
features: Numerous blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and occasional visible nucleoli
Dysplastic megakaryocyte (bottom center) with two widely separated round nuclear lobes and vacuolated granular cytoplasm
Scattered small lymphocytes and erythroid precursors with dense nuclei
Red cells unremarkable at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at intermediate power shows a predominance of blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and occasional nucleoli, admixed with scattered erythroid precursors, lymphocytes and hypogranular myeloid cells. A dysplastic megakaryocyte at the bottom center has two widely separated round nuclear lobes and vacuolated granular cytoplasm. Auer rods are not identified. With 72% blasts, multilineage dysplasia and inv(3)(q21q26.2), findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with inv(3)/MECOM rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Multilineage dysplasia is shared; cytogenetic detection of inv(3)/t(3;3) takes precedence and defines the MECOM-rearranged entity.
Morphology and even inv(3) can occur after therapy; a history of prior cytotoxic treatment is the distinguishing factor.
Megaloblastic change can produce multinucleated megakaryocytes and dysplasia but blasts are not increased and B12/folate levels are low.
